sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A clumsy spirit from the illustrated book "Storm of Legend" written by the Fabula brothers. According to the story, Mei-Lin brought forth a great calamity upon the forest and was sealed away as punishment. Having appeared out of nowhere, and as a spirit no less, the villagers sought to vanquish her. A talented illustrator who was in the area attempted to stop them, but the negativity surrounding the incident only fueled the villagers' anger. As the situation grew worse so did the weather, and a terrifying storm eventually hit the village.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Storm Spirit Mei-Lin |bf2 = true }} '''Mei-Lin''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== A clumsy spirit from the illustrated book "Storm of Legend" written by the Fabula brothers. According to the story, Mei-Lin brought forth a great calamity upon the forest and was sealed away as punishment. Having appeared out of nowhere, and as a spirit no less, the villagers sought to vanquish her. A talented illustrator who was in the area attempted to stop them, but the negativity surrounding the incident only fueled the villagers' anger.
